title: HTML Basics
description: HTML structure, elements, semantic tags, and document fundamentals.
fullDescription: Understanding HTML document structure, semantic elements, headings, text formatting, links, lists, and media elements.

title: HTML Forms & CSS Basics
description: Form elements, input types, validation, and introduction to CSS styling methods.
fullDescription: Building interactive forms with various input types, validation attributes, and learning the three ways to apply CSS: inline, internal, and external.

title: CSS Selectors & Box Model
description: CSS selectors, specificity, box model, and positioning fundamentals.
fullDescription: Mastering element, class, and ID selectors, understanding specificity, the box model with margin and padding, and CSS positioning properties.

title: CSS Flexbox
description: Flexbox layout, alignment, distribution, and responsive design patterns.
fullDescription: Understanding display flex, flex containers and items, justify-content, align-items, flex-grow, flex-wrap, and building responsive layouts.

title: CSS Animations & Advanced
description: Animations, pseudo-elements, CSS variables, gradients, and Bootstrap basics.
fullDescription: Creating keyframe animations, using pseudo-elements and classes, CSS custom properties, transitions, box shadows, and introduction to Bootstrap framework.
